configuration.title: Easy Coding Standard
configuration.executablePath.description: Path to the ECS executable. Relative paths are resolved from the detected project root, falling back to the workspace folder.
configuration.configPath.description: Path to the ECS configuration file (ecs.php). Relative paths are searched upward from the document's directory to the workspace folder, so nested projects can each have their own config.
configuration.memoryLimit.description: Memory limit for the ECS process
configuration.timeout.description: Timeout for ECS command execution in milliseconds
